**Motif:** fork

**Explanation (80 words):**
When your opponent moves into the open, look for forcing checks that drive the king toward traps. Here, Qf5+ checks the king and controls all escape squares. If Kh4, Qh5 is checkmate—the king can't return to g5 or go to g3. If Kh6, Qf6 is mate for the same reason. The lesson: whenever you can give check with a queen that also controls key escape squares, calculate it carefully—the king often has nowhere safe to go.
